properties.title: Header Validation Before Body Execution
properties.description: Block body must not be executed until block header has passed all consensus rule checks
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: execute_body(block) IMPLIES header_validated(block)

properties.title: Invalid Header Rejects Block
properties.description: When header validation fails, the entire block must be rejected with InvalidBlock exception
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: NOT header_validated(block) IMPLIES block.rejected() AND error.type == 'InvalidBlock'

properties.title: Merkle Root Integrity
properties.description: Block finalization requires computed Merkle roots for transactions, receipts, withdrawals, and state to match header values
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: block.finalized() IMPLIES block.computed_tx_root == block.header.tx_root AND block.computed_receipt_root == block.header.receipt_root AND block.computed_state_root == block.header.state_root AND block.computed_withdrawal_root == block.header.withdrawal_root

properties.title: Transaction Nonce Must Match Sender Account
properties.description: Transaction nonce must exactly match sender account's current nonce
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: tx.valid() IMPLIES tx.nonce == get_account(tx.sender).nonce

properties.title: Sender Must Have Sufficient Balance
properties.description: Sender must have sufficient balance to cover gas fees and value transfer
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: tx.valid() IMPLIES get_account(tx.sender).balance >= tx.gas_limit * tx.max_fee_per_gas + tx.value

properties.title: Sender Must Be EOA
properties.description: Transaction sender must be an externally-owned account, not a contract
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: tx.valid() IMPLIES get_account(tx.sender).code.empty()

properties.title: Blob Transaction Versioned Hash Format
properties.description: Blob transaction versioned hashes must use KZG commitment version (0x01 prefix)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : BlobTransaction :: tx.valid() IMPLIES FORALL hash : tx.blob_versioned_hashes :: hash[0] == 0x01

properties.title: EIP-1559 Base Fee Update Formula
properties.description: Base fee adjustment must follow EIP-1559 formula with max 12.5% change per block
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: abs(block.base_fee - parent.base_fee) / parent.base_fee <= 0.125 AND (block.gas_used > TARGET_GAS IMPLIES block.base_fee >= parent.base_fee) AND (block.gas_used < TARGET_GAS IMPLIES block.base_fee <= parent.base_fee)

properties.title: Gas Limit Adjustment Bounds
properties.description: Block gas limit must be within parent_limit/1024 of parent and at least 5000
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: abs(block.gas_limit - parent.gas_limit) <= parent.gas_limit / 1024 AND block.gas_limit >= 5000

properties.title: Gas Refund Capped at 20%
properties.description: Gas refund must be capped at 20% of gas consumed during execution
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: tx.refund <= tx.gas_consumed * 0.20

properties.title: Sender Nonce Incremented After Execution
properties.description: After transaction execution, sender's nonce must be incremented by exactly 1
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: AFTER(execute(tx)) IMPLIES get_account(tx.sender).nonce == OLD(get_account(tx.sender).nonce) + 1

properties.title: Priority Fee Paid to Block Proposer
properties.description: After transaction execution, priority fee must be credited to block proposer
properties.formal_expression: FORALL tx : Transaction :: AFTER(execute(tx)) IMPLIES proposer.balance_increase >= (tx.effective_gas_price - block.base_fee) * tx.gas_used

properties.title: Withdrawal Amount Conversion to Wei
properties.description: Withdrawal amounts must be converted from Gwei to Wei (multiply by 10^9)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL withdrawal : Withdrawal :: withdrawal.wei_amount == withdrawal.gwei_amount * 10^9

properties.title: Withdrawal Credits Recipient Balance
properties.description: After withdrawal processing, recipient balance must increase by withdrawal amount in Wei
properties.formal_expression: FORALL withdrawal : Withdrawal :: AFTER(process_withdrawals) IMPLIES get_account(withdrawal.address).balance == OLD(get_account(withdrawal.address).balance) + withdrawal.wei_amount

properties.title: SHL Gas Cost Constant
properties.description: SHL instruction must consume exactly 3 gas (verylow tier)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shl : SHLInstruction :: shl.gas_cost == 3

properties.title: SHL Out-of-Bounds Returns Zero
properties.description: When shift amount >= 256, SHL must return 0
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shl : SHLInstruction :: shl.shift_amount >= 256 IMPLIES shl.result == 0

properties.title: SHL Computation Formula
properties.description: SHL computes (value * 2^shift) mod 2^256
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shl : SHLInstruction :: shl.shift_amount < 256 IMPLIES shl.result == (shl.value * 2^shl.shift_amount) mod 2^256

properties.title: SHR Gas Cost Constant
properties.description: SHR instruction must consume exactly 3 gas (verylow tier)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shr : SHRInstruction :: shr.gas_cost == 3

properties.title: SHR Out-of-Bounds Returns Zero
properties.description: When shift amount >= 256, SHR must return 0
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shr : SHRInstruction :: shr.shift_amount >= 256 IMPLIES shr.result == 0

properties.title: SHR Computation Formula (Logical Shift)
properties.description: SHR computes floor(value / 2^shift) with zero fill
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shr : SHRInstruction :: shr.shift_amount < 256 IMPLIES shr.result == floor(shr.value / 2^shr.shift_amount)

properties.title: SAR Gas Cost Constant
properties.description: SAR instruction must consume exactly 3 gas (verylow tier)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sar : SARInstruction :: sar.gas_cost == 3

properties.title: SAR Out-of-Bounds Positive Returns Zero
properties.description: When shift >= 256 and value is non-negative, SAR must return 0
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sar : SARInstruction :: sar.shift_amount >= 256 AND sar.value >= 0 (signed) IMPLIES sar.result == 0

properties.title: SAR Out-of-Bounds Negative Returns All Ones
properties.description: When shift >= 256 and value is negative (sign bit set), SAR must return -1 (all 1s)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sar : SARInstruction :: sar.shift_amount >= 256 AND sar.value < 0 (signed) IMPLIES sar.result == 2^256 - 1

properties.title: SAR Sign Extension Behavior
properties.description: SAR preserves sign bit by filling shifted positions with sign bit value
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sar : SARInstruction :: sar.shift_amount < 256 IMPLIES sar.result == floor(to_signed(sar.value) / 2^sar.shift_amount)

properties.title: Shift Instructions More Efficient Than Arithmetic
properties.description: Native shift instructions (3 gas) must be more efficient than arithmetic workarounds (35 gas)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL shift : ShiftInstruction :: shift.gas_cost < arithmetic_shift_workaround.gas_cost AND 3 < 35

properties.title: Fake Block Number Offset
properties.description: Post-London fork, fake block number must be max(0, block.number - 9,700,000)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: london_active(block) IMPLIES fake_block_number == max(0, block.number - 9700000)

properties.title: Fork Block Determines Difficulty Rules
properties.description: Modified difficulty calculation only applies at or after London fork block
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: uses_eip3554_rules(block) IMPLIES block.number >= LONDON_FORK_BLOCK

properties.title: Difficulty Validation Rejects Mismatch
properties.description: Block must be rejected if claimed difficulty doesn't match computed expected difficulty
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: block.claimed_difficulty != compute_expected_difficulty(block) IMPLIES block.rejected()

properties.title: Difficulty Bomb Uses Fake Block Number
properties.description: Difficulty bomb term calculation must use fake block number, not actual block number
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: london_active(block) IMPLIES bomb_term == 2^(floor(fake_block_number/100000) - 2)

properties.title: Bomb Effects Delayed by Offset
properties.description: After fork activation, difficulty bomb effects are delayed by approximately 9.7 million blocks
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: london_active(block) AND block.number < LONDON_FORK_BLOCK + 9700000 IMPLIES bomb_effect(block) == bomb_effect(genesis)
